user.title: Ready Home
user.description: Track emergency supplies and measure readiness. Name this profile (default Ready Home). Generic names appear as Ready Home in the UI; other names become a suffix, e.g. Ready Home (Cabin). The profile also sets the entity id prefix.

data.name: Profile name
data.number_of_people: Number of adults in the household (children, seniors and toddlers can be added later in options)

init.title: Ready Home options
init.description: Submit saves and returns here. Close when finished.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Rename this readiness profile (default Ready Home). Generic names appear as Ready Home; other names become a suffix, e.g. Ready Home (Cabin). The profile also sets the entity id prefix.

targets.title: Readiness targets

data.calories_per_day_adults: Adults (18–69): calories per person per day
data.water_liters_per_day_adults: Adults (18–69): water liters per person per day
data.calories_per_day_children: Children (4–17): calories per person per day
data.water_liters_per_day_children: Children (4–17): water liters per person per day
data.count_babies_toddlers: Babies and toddlers (0–3): number of people
data.calories_per_day_babies_toddlers: Babies and toddlers (0–3): calories per person per day
data.water_liters_per_day_babies_toddlers: Babies and toddlers (0–3): water liters per person per day
data.calories_per_day_seniors: Seniors (70+): calories per person per day
data.water_liters_per_day_seniors: Seniors (70+): water liters per person per day

targets.description: People per age category and their daily needs. Defaults follow Voedingscentrum.nl (light activity) and can be changed. Totals are the sum over all categories.

pets.title: Pets
pets.description: Pets add their daily water to the household water target and their daily food to a separate pet food target (grams). Add as many as you like.

pet_add.title: Add a pet
pet_add.description: Enter what this pet needs per day.

pet_remove.title: Remove a pet
pet_remove.description: The pet no longer counts toward the targets.

lists.title: Locations and categories
lists.description: Categories label items. Food, water and pet food category lists decide which categories count toward readiness. A category can only be one of food, water or pet food.

data_description.food_categories: Items in these categories count toward food readiness (calories).
data_description.water_categories: Items in these categories count toward water readiness (liters).
data_description.pet_food_categories: Items in these categories count toward pet food readiness (grams).

restock.title: Restock
restock.description: Push low-stock items to a Home Assistant todo / shopping list. Optional auto-push runs when an item newly becomes low stock.

error.category_overlap: A category can only be food, water or pet food
error.invalid_pet_amount: Enter food and water amounts of 0 or more
